_comment: Monster fights (Instigator). Names are the monsters' AI script types (the same in every language). neverAttack: never sent at another monster (stationary, teleporting, attaching or swarm AIs, and the ones with no navigation: CeilingEye, ThinMan, HeartHugger, Oogly). neverTarget: never attacked. Bosses (the mod's tier 3+) only attack with the Feud capstone. A type listed here that this game version doesn't have is logged once and ignored.
